scope.legalityPolicy: Original cards retained regardless of Commander legality; ban status is informational. Structure, color identity and engine eligibility remain enforced.

fullSuite.note: The complete suite ran while browser-discovered fixes were being applied. No exact full-run starting hash manifest was captured. Its 23 failures are preserved below; every affected complete test file was rerun, except the Oracle aggregate which reran all 56 failing card names and all their operations. The full suite was not repeated after corrections.

failures.name: unsupported, malformed and built-in-collision decks never mutate storage or runtime
failures.resolution: Agitator Ant is now certified through an active precon. The unsupported-card fixture now uses the still-excluded Boros Reckoner.

failures.name: the complete pinned legacy card set remains represented exactly once in the runtime catalog
failures.resolution: Added the explicit 149-card native cohort while preserving the pinned original legacy digest and all earlier cohorts.

failures.name: runtime card art uses local WebP except the explicit API fallback list
failures.resolution: Added canonical Faerie Rogue and Hydra token aliases to original token artwork. The exact manifest assertion handles shared canonical token aliases and includes source card faces.

failures.name: svaka generička Oracle karta i svaki deklarisani keyword imaju izvršni dokaz
failures.resolution: The proof recorder intercepted single-copy calls but missed the new simultaneous copy batch path. It now records and resolves every returned batch copy. All 116 failed execution contexts belong to the 56-card rerun; 216 invariant games pass.
failures.resolvedBy: copy-proof-final.log: all 56 affected Oracle names, both controller roles and every declared operation

browser.controlledFixtures: Every selector/pod/review/opening is normal UI flow. Follow-on paid casts and commander mechanic cases use explicit prepared boards in the browser scripts.

all opening controls visible at 1365×768 and correct local AI seats instantiated
guest-2 private controls retain focus across sync and play Forest
guest pays mana, casts Sol Ring onto shared Stack, all humans pass and resolution reaches battlefield
mixed-table guest reload and host resume preserve the human seat
every configured local bot independently plays a land
no browser page or console errors

visuallyInspected: Gavi Dinosaur Cat token on desktop
browser.timing: Browser runs preceded the final endCombatStep fix, token aliases and Sneak Attack year metadata. Complete affected unit files and all eight deck games were verified afterward.

assertions: no logged AI fallback or fatal error

limitations: Native registration, strict certification and controlled execution are complementary checks, not exhaustive proof of every possible card combination.
Merged mutate graphs and lasting linked permissions that cannot yet be serialized portably retain the preceding safe save checkpoint; they are not silently discarded.
No new commander intro videos were generated.
